tours.name: Check the Payslip of a Mid-Month Joiner or Leaver

name_i18n.en_US: Check the Payslip of a Mid-Month Joiner or Leaver

tours.description: Learn how to verify the pay of an employee who joins or leaves during the month: check the contract start and end dates, then confirm on the payslip that only the days under contract are paid.

description_i18n.en_US: Learn how to verify the pay of an employee who joins or leaves during the month: check the contract start and end dates, then confirm on the payslip that only the days under contract are paid.

steps.title: Open Payroll
steps.description: A payslip for someone who joins or leaves in the middle of a month must only cover the days they were under contract. Start by checking the contract dates.

description_i18n.en_US: A payslip for someone who joins or leaves in the middle of a month must only cover the days they were under contract. Start by checking the contract dates.

steps.title: Contracts menu
steps.description: The Contracts menu lists the employment contracts that payroll uses to compute the pay.

description_i18n.en_US: The Contracts menu lists the employment contracts that payroll uses to compute the pay.

steps.title: Contracts
steps.description: This list shows every contract with its status, start date and end date.

description_i18n.en_US: This list shows every contract with its status, start date and end date.

steps.title: Open a group
steps.content: Click a group to show its contracts.

content_i18n.en_US: Click a group to show its contracts.

steps.description: Contracts are grouped by status. Expand Running to see the current contracts, or Expired for people who have left.

description_i18n.en_US: Contracts are grouped by status. Expand Running to see the current contracts, or Expired for people who have left.

steps.title: Start date
steps.content: Look at the Start Date column, then click it to continue.

content_i18n.en_US: Look at the Start Date column, then click it to continue.

steps.description: The start date is the first day the employee is paid. For a joiner in the middle of a month, the first payslip only counts the days from this date.

description_i18n.en_US: The start date is the first day the employee is paid. For a joiner in the middle of a month, the first payslip only counts the days from this date.

steps.title: End date
steps.content: Look at the End Date column, then click it to continue.

content_i18n.en_US: Look at the End Date column, then click it to continue.

steps.description: The end date is the last day the employee is paid. For a leaver, the last payslip only counts the days up to this date. An empty end date means the contract has no end.

description_i18n.en_US: The end date is the last day the employee is paid. For a leaver, the last payslip only counts the days up to this date. An empty end date means the contract has no end.

steps.title: Payslips menu
steps.description: Now check that the payslip of the employee agrees with the contract dates.

description_i18n.en_US: Now check that the payslip of the employee agrees with the contract dates.

steps.title: All Payslips
steps.description: This list shows every payslip. Find the payslip of the joiner or leaver for the month.

description_i18n.en_US: This list shows every payslip. Find the payslip of the joiner or leaver for the month.

steps.title: Open a batch
steps.content: Click a batch name to show its payslips.

content_i18n.en_US: Click a batch name to show its payslips.

steps.description: Payslips are grouped by batch. Expand the batch of the month you are checking.

description_i18n.en_US: Payslips are grouped by batch. Expand the batch of the month you are checking.

steps.title: Open the payslip
steps.content: Click the payslip to open it.

content_i18n.en_US: Click the payslip to open it.

steps.description: The payslip shows the employee, the period and the contract used to compute it.

description_i18n.en_US: The payslip shows the employee, the period and the contract used to compute it.

steps.title: Worked days and inputs
steps.content: Click the Worked Days & Inputs tab.

content_i18n.en_US: Click the Worked Days & Inputs tab.

steps.description: This tab shows the days and hours that are paid. For a joiner or leaver, the number of days must be lower than a full month and match the days between the contract start and end dates.

description_i18n.en_US: This tab shows the days and hours that are paid. For a joiner or leaver, the number of days must be lower than a full month and match the days between the contract start and end dates.

steps.title: Worked days lines
steps.content: Compare the days with the contract dates, then click the table to finish.

content_i18n.en_US: Compare the days with the contract dates, then click the table to finish.

steps.description: If the days are wrong, fix the contract dates or the work entries and click Compute Sheet again to recalculate the payslip.

description_i18n.en_US: If the days are wrong, fix the contract dates or the work entries and click Compute Sheet again to recalculate the payslip.
